Evidence: Privilege Pass ke liye railway servant ko apne request par privilege pass ya privilege ticket order diya ja sakta hai. Ye pass self, family, dependent relatives aur adopted child ke liye admissible hain (Source 2). Pass ka issue hone ke liye specific conditions aur categories hain jo Schedule-II mein specified hain (Source 2).
